additional_info.subject: Request for Warranty Approval – Replacement of DLogic Qfeedback 2310 HMI Screens
additional_info.body:
Dear Team,
I would like to ask if we can replace the HMI screens for the following charging stations:
170000903
170000124
160365534
170000125
A symptom developed on the DLogic under Qfeedback 2310 HMI screens of these stations quite some time ago.
However, we were unable to perform the replacements over the past two years since the sites were in closed areas due to the war.
We would now like to proceed with replacing the defective HMI screens for the customer and submit a warranty claim for these units.
Could you please check with the Warranty Claims Department if these replacements can be approved under warranty, so we can proceed with ordering the new units and inform the customer accordingly?
Thank you for your support.
Best regards,
Orel Lachiani
GSW Integration Engineer & E-Mobility Expert
